result.changelog: Fixed the one error: Kraid on ZDR is "killed once more" after two defeats on Zebes, not "a second time". Unverified items each got one check. Removed: the Chozo mural (06WB), Corpius walking on its arms with exposed ribs (now its tail strike, tail sweep and acid spit, per Dread Report Vol 11), the Thoha giving DNA to Samus, Samus vowing to avenge Quiet Robe (Metroid Wiki says only that she will finish the fight), "set out on a new mission", and the Core-X drop for Chozo Soldiers. Confirmed and kept: 04SB could be outrun (Metroid Wiki E.M.M.I.), Z-57 in Cataris (walkthroughs found by search), and the Metroid Suit name and Hyper Beam (search snippets only). Added missing facts: ZDR's environment is like SR388's and a central system circulates its magma (Vol 8); Ferenia is a ruined ritual sanctuary, Dairon is full of Chozo robots, Ghavoran is a sunlit forest, and Burenia's connections; 02SM, Charge Beam and Spider Magnet are in Artaria; E.M.M.I. were built to capture creatures and extract DNA (Vol 1); zone gates and the Phantom Cloak silencing footsteps (Vol 2); the first Central Unit was already destroyed and draining 07PB destroyed its Central Unit; two counter windows; Raven Beak's right-arm cannon and his size (Vol 7); Chozo Soldiers carry spears, and the robots have blade arms and light-orb cannons. Corrected: X "suppressed" not "eliminated"; the Chozo Memory follows Wikipedia's wording (no "armored"); "destroyed the exit"; "dedicated" rather than "shielded" communication rooms; the Elun X release is worded so both source readings fit; "both tribes were gone" timing; ADAM's urging to destroy ZDR is no longer pinned on the impostor. Keys: ZDR incident and ZDR mission now sit only on the mission entry. Dropped research robot(s), Chozo warrior(s), the duplicate ADAM key and the generic secondaries fake, false and impersonat*. Dropped X on ZDR and Kraid X because the X Parasite domain owns them. Mission entry trimmed from 510 to 402 words, creatures entry retitled, orders set to 90 for the index and bestiary entries, selective_logic added to every entry.
result.unresolved: Not added: the fact-check's "Federation archives record a warrior-type Chozo tribe" (not found when Dread Report Vol 7 was re-read). Sources conflict on who gave the Power Bomb: Metroid Wiki's Power Bomb page says a Red Chozo Soldier, its E.M.M.I. and ZDR pages say 07PB; 07PB is used. Wikipedia's character list says Raven Beak released the X, while its plot says Samus did so by accident; content is worded neutrally. Only search snippets back the Metroid Suit name and the Hyper Beam. Still unverified and left out: Drogyga's appearance, the Phantom Cloak coming after Corpius, Elite Chozo Soldier, and the Network Station name. Mission entry is 402 words, just over 400.
